title: Compare entity and relationship states across all reading surfaces
preconditions: Disposable format-2 Saga using the PDF inventory fixture: implemented PDF report held by Record store, proposed JSON PDF job held by Job queue, report-to-job production relationship, application ERD, and pdf-jobs overlay; the reporting ERD also includes a job association with owner 0..many and destination unknown.
Record exact entity/relationship revision pins and a named baseline/head; include implemented report, code-free proposed job and proposed production edge.

steps.action: Read the same pins in ERD, directory, details and public inventory query, then inspect their relationships.
steps.expected_result: Each surface preserves each selected revision's explicit proposed/implemented state independently of relationship state.

steps.action: Repeat for System, Component and data entity references with missing evidence, changed source bytes and an unavailable source commit, retaining the same inventory revisions; inspect documentation code captions and query health.
steps.expected_result: Exact source commit/path/range and evidence health are visible where evidence is recorded; missing or unavailable evidence is explicit; comparison newness and proposed/implemented intent remain separate and neither is inferred from code availability.
